paragraphs: R' Yitzchak, his son — Yevamot, chapter 1, halakhah 1.[^1]

notes.text: The ordinary בריה is rendered his son with an implicit contextual antecedent, rather than the older speculative personal name Bareih or son of Rabbi gloss. Yitzchak's title remains R'. The locator is chapter1, halakhah1, suggestive of Jerusalem Talmud but not independently verified.
